say:4:1421618001:1.text: Ha! They picked the wrong people to mess with today. Didn't take them long to tuck tail and run!

say:8:1421618004:1.text: When my master tasked me with getting some Mystic Dew, he only mentioned its unique scent was quite popular among the nobility.
